description: Every article as one plain-text document, for bulk ingestion rather than reading. PREFLIGHT FIRST: call it with sizeOnly=true for the exact character count, a token estimate and the per-branch breakdown — the whole corpus is several times a context window. Then pull it with `maxChars` (default 200000, max 1000000), or narrow it with `tagPath` to take one branch at a time. Truncation is page-aligned and honest: `truncated`, `omittedPages` and `nextSkip` say exactly where to resume (pass skip=nextSkip). Search or list first if you have a question; the same corpus is also served, cacheably and with an ETag, at /llms-full.txt.

sizeOnly.description: Return sizes and breakdowns only, no document. Do this before the first real pull.

skip.description: Resume from this page index — pass the `nextSkip` from the previous truncated call (default 0)

tagPath.description: Restrict to one branch and its descendants, e.g. "contents/tech". Omit for everything.
